offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription medicines for opioid use disorder, including long-acting injectable and sublingual film forms of buprenorphine. Sells to wholesalers, pharmacies, treatment clinics and health systems, and manufactures or contracts for production of its products.

primary_products.value: extended-release buprenorphine injection; buprenorphine sublingual film; buprenorphine tablets

customer_segment.value: B2B: wholesalers, retail pharmacies, hospitals, addiction treatment clinics, health systems; B2G: government health programs and state purchasers

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription medicines sold to wholesalers, pharmacies and providers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets its branded medicines, sold to wholesalers and providers; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures or contracts production of its medicines, sold to distributors and pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: opioid use disorder treatment products only

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers that supply pharmacies and providers; third-party retail: retail pharmacies dispensing its medicines to patients; direct sales: sales teams calling on treatment clinics and health systems
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs needing FDA approval and controlled-substance scheduling rules from the DEA
